whereNext.heading: Where next?
whereNext.intro: Ideas to start from, from a weekend away to the trip of a lifetime. Every one is a starting point, not a package.

destinations.title: Seychelles
destinations.summary: Granite coves, clear water and very little to do. From the beaches of Mahé to a private island of your own, we’ll match the stay to the pace you want.

image.alt: Two paddleboarders on clear turquoise water

destinations._note: INTERNAL ONLY: Belmond video used as a placeholder, not licensed for public use.

destinations.title: Rhodes
destinations.summary: Whitewashed Lindos above a sheltered bay, a medieval old town and day sails to Symi. Easy to reach, and easy to stretch into two weeks of islands.

image.alt: Lindos bay in Rhodes with the acropolis above the beach

destinations.title: Crete
destinations.summary: Harbour towns, mountain villages and long lunches by the water. Good for families, better with a villa and a driver who knows the back roads.

destinations.title: Corfu
destinations.summary: Green hills dropping into quiet coves on the north-east coast. Take a boat for the day and stop wherever looks good.

image.alt: A cove on the coast of Corfu

destinations._note: INTERNAL ONLY: Belmond video used as a placeholder, not licensed for public use.

destinations.title: Puglia
destinations.summary: Masserie among the olive groves, white towns and the clearest sea in Italy. Best explored slowly, with dinner booked for you each night.

image.alt: Cliffs and clear water on the Puglia coast

faq.heading: Good to know
faq.intro: Anything else, message us and a person will reply.

items.a: A private, invitation-only membership. Members get their own travel agent on WhatsApp, member rates at over 1 million stays, and partner privileges like upgrades and breakfast where available.
No. There is no membership fee. You pay for your trips, at member rates.
Use the invitation a member sent you, or request one with the form on this page. Someone from our team reads every request.

items.q: How long does it take to hear back about my request?
items.a: We reply to every request personally, by email or on WhatsApp. If a member invited you, have their code to hand.

items.q: What kind of trips can my agent help with?
items.a: Anything travel-related: a hotel for the weekend, flights, or a longer trip across several places. Simple stays come back quickly; bigger trips get the time they deserve.

items.q: What are the requirements to join?
items.a: Premium is designed for people who travel often. Tell us a little about how you travel and we will take it from there.
Yes. Choose Company on the request form and tell us about the way your team travels.

items.q: Can I invite friends or family?
items.a: Yes. Members can share invitation links with the people they travel with.
Membership is personal and non-transferable, and is offered in line with our terms.

cta.heading: Travel, looked after.
cta.body: Request an invitation, or use the code a member sent you.
